n8n-vs-zapier.title: n8n vs Zapier (2026): pricing, self-hosting & which to pick
n8n-vs-zapier.description: n8n vs Zapier compared with checked Oct 2026 pricing: n8n bills per workflow run and can be self-hosted free; Zapier bills per task and connects 9,000+ apps.
n8n-vs-zapier.bottomLine: Pick Zapier if you want the biggest app catalog and the quickest no-code setup and your Zaps have only a few steps. Pick n8n if you are comfortable with a more technical tool, want to self-host for free or keep data on your own server, or run long multi-step workflows: n8n counts one execution per full run, while Zapier counts a task for every successful action step.

faq: Is n8n cheaper than Zapier?

It depends on your workflows. n8n Cloud starts at €20/month (billed annually) and charges per full workflow run; Zapier Professional starts at $19.99/month (billed annually) for 750 tasks, and every successful action step uses a task. For long multi-step workflows n8n usually works out cheaper, and self-hosted n8n Community Edition is free. Prices checked Oct 20, 2026.
Can I self-host Zapier like n8n?
No. Zapier only runs in its own cloud. n8n can be self-hosted for free with the Community Edition, or used on n8n Cloud.
Does Zapier have a free plan?
Yes: 100 tasks per month with two-step Zaps (one trigger, one action). Multi-step Zaps, premium apps and webhooks need a paid plan.

chatgpt-vs-claude.title: ChatGPT vs Claude (2026): pricing, agents & which to pick
chatgpt-vs-claude.description: ChatGPT vs Claude compared with checked Oct 2026 plan pages: Claude Pro is $20/month or $17/month billed annually ($200) and now includes Claude Duet (US research preview). ChatGPT offers Free, Go, Plus and Pro individual tiers (Plus includes Codex and deep research).
chatgpt-vs-claude.bottomLine: Pick ChatGPT if you want the largest consumer ecosystem, plugins, image gen, Codex and deep research on Plus (or higher). Pick Claude if you want Claude Code, Artifacts, and (in the US on Pro/Max) Claude Duet as a proactive background agent. Both have free tiers; heavy daily use may need ChatGPT Pro or Claude Max (from $100/month).

faq: Is Claude Pro cheaper than ChatGPT Plus?

Claude Pro is $20/month or $17/month if you pay $200 for the year. ChatGPT lists Free, Go, Plus and Pro; check openai.com/chatgpt/pricing for the current Plus amount in your country. Prices checked Oct 21, 2026; tax may apply.
Does ChatGPT Plus include a coding agent like Claude Code?
Plus includes OpenAI's coding tools (Codex and related features) that share the plan's usage. Claude Pro includes Claude Code in the terminal and desktop, also sharing the same usage pool as chat.
Which is better for beginners?

Either free tier is enough to try. If you mostly chat and want plugins or image tools, start with ChatGPT. If you want to build small apps or long docs in the chat (Artifacts) or try an agent in the terminal, start with Claude.
What is Claude Duet, and does ChatGPT have the same thing?

Claude Duet is Anthropic's standalone proactive agent (waitlist, US Pro/Max as of Oct 23, 2026). It watches connected apps, works in a cloud VM, and asks before consequential actions. ChatGPT has custom GPTs and coding tools on Plus+, but not the same always-on brief-and-act agent product yet. Source: claude.com/product/claude-duet.

cursor-vs-github-copilot.title: Cursor vs GitHub Copilot (2026): pricing, agents & which to pick
cursor-vs-github-copilot.description: Cursor vs GitHub Copilot compared with checked Oct 2026 pricing: Cursor is sold on The X Subscription (Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200/mo). Copilot Pro is $10/mo, Pro+ $39/mo, Max $100/mo with GitHub AI Credits.
cursor-vs-github-copilot.bottomLine: Pick GitHub Copilot if you already live in GitHub issues/PRs and want the cheapest paid coding assistant (Pro $10/mo) with unlimited completions. Pick Cursor (The X Subscription Premium $30/mo or higher) if you want an agent-first IDE with cloud agents, Origin code hosting and Bugbot—know that third-party models on Cursor bill at API list price from prepaid credit, and Plus ($8) is Grok models only.

faq: Is Cursor still $20/month Pro?

New customers buy The X Subscription (Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200). Legacy Cursor Pro at $20/mo continues for existing subscribers until they switch. Prices checked Oct 22, 2026 from cursor.com/help/account-and-billing/pricing.
Does Copilot Pro include unlimited completions?
Yes on paid plans: code completions and next-edit suggestions do not use AI Credits. Agent mode, chat, CLI and cloud features consume credits. Source: GitHub Copilot plans FAQ.
Which is cheaper to start?

GitHub Copilot Pro at $10/mo is the cheapest paid coding plan in this pair. Cursor Plus is $8 but only unlocks Grok models inside Cursor; for multi-model agent work Cursor recommends Premium at $30/mo.
